entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Hi... I hope someone can help me. I need to return something.
Hello, you've reached VeloFit, my name is David. I can certainly look into that for you. Do you have your order number handy?
Yes, it's VF886-0921. I'm just so disappointed, I saved up for these.

Okay, one moment while I pull that up... VF886-0921. I see the order here for the Velo-Pro cycling shoes. I'm sorry to hear you're disappointed. What specifically is the issue with them? Is it a technical fault or a preference issue?

I guess it's preference? They just hurt so much. I've tried adjusting the cleats in every possible position, but after about an hour of riding I get awful blisters. I've been a loyal customer for a long time, and I've never had an issue like this. I was really hoping these would work.

I completely understand, and I'm very sorry about that experience. Getting blisters is definitely not what we want for our riders. Let me just check the return eligibility for you. I see the delivery was about 84 days ago.
Is that... is that too long? I really needed to get that money back. With the holidays, things are just so tight.
No need to worry at all. Let's see... yes, our policy allows for returns within 90 days. You are well within that window, so I can absolutely process a full refund for you.
Oh, thank goodness! That is such a relief. Thank you, David. I was so worried.

Of course, I'm happy we could sort this out. I've just processed the return authorization. You'll get an email shortly with a prepaid shipping label. Just package up the cycling shoes, attach the label, and drop them at a post office. Once our warehouse receives them, your refund will be issued.
That's perfect. Thank you again so much for your help.
You're very welcome. Was there anything else I could assist you with today?
No, that was everything. You've been great.
My pleasure. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a wonderful day.
